title: Scammed migrant workers in UK to be considered possible victims of modern slavery
summary_full: Home Office changes policy after legal challenge over case of care worker scammed out of £22,000Migrant workers who are financially exploited can now be considered victims of modern slavery, after a legal challenge by a care worker who was scammed out of £22,000 to pay an agent for a job in the UK that did not exist.The care worker, Ali*, from Pakistan, was put in contact with an agent who told him he could organise a certificate of sponsorship for him to work in a UK care home. The agent was recommended by a friend who said he had been helped to secure a UK care job. Continue reading...
